info.title: TMS internal work items S06
info.description: ADR-006 and 2026-10-08 ordinary-work closure: PM can finish TASK/REQUEST/IMPROVEMENT as closed/wontfix and explicitly reopen to open. BUG closure/reopen and QA commands remain in their typed APIs.

post.description: Tạo BUG/REQUEST/TASK/IMPROVEMENT. QA không được tạo qua endpoint này; sử dụng typed QA API. Không có subtype-less QA hoặc generic QA replay.

titlePrefix.description: Tiền tố rule bổ sung hiện hành cho bug mới.

canCreate.description: Legacy generic creation affordance; does not grant QA creation. Commands still validate project/archive state.

canCreateQa.description: Current active PM/TESTER, non-global-DEV, unarchived project. Generic canCreate does not grant QA creation.

post.description: Current project PM may finish TASK/REQUEST/IMPROVEMENT as closed or wontfix, or reopen a terminal ordinary item only to open. Required nonblank reason and expectedVersion; fixedBuildId is forbidden for ordinary work. Terminal content edits require reopen. BUG generic terminal transitions remain forbidden; assigned Dev can only progress/resolve their BUG. QA requires typed commands. Archived projects reject writes.
PM only; every item obeys the same type-specific transition rules. One invalid item rolls back the whole batch. QA is rejected before any write. Ordinary closure never bypasses BUG retest closure.

200.description: Authorized forced download; nosniff, attachment, CSP sandbox, no-store

type.description: QA được nhận diện nhưng generic POST trả 409 QA_COMMAND_REQUIRED; tạo QA qua POST /projects/{projectId}/qa.

CreateWorkItem.description: BUG additionally requires nonblank steps/expectedResult/actualResult and build/environment/device. Exact NG context if attemptId is given; otherwise revisionId, or project PM with standaloneReason. Classification fields require project PM except default MEDIUM priority.

Transition.description: Status destinations are further constrained by current role, item type and state. Only TASK/REQUEST/IMPROVEMENT accept closed/wontfix here; terminal ordinary work can only reopen to open. BUG closure and QA use typed APIs.

BatchTransition.description: All items apply Transition type-specific rules in one atomic transaction. fixedBuildId is not accepted when a TASK/REQUEST/IMPROVEMENT is included.

ruleVersionId.description: Snapshot rule INTERNAL_DEMO lúc tạo bug; null cho bug cũ/không có rule bổ sung.

statusLabel.description: Type-specific canonical status label; QA resolved means answered, not a fixed BUG.

capabilities.description: QA current typed capabilities. Generic allowedTransitions is empty for QA.
